quests.1980: Wolves on the eastern shore. The guard asks you to protect the camp: reach the eastern part of the island after your training and defeat the three wolves.
quests.1981: Camp supplies. The crates have been counted and the supplies stored in the house. This task is complete.
quests.1982: The soaked letter. A letter left on the shore was swept away by the tide. It is too late to recover it.
quests.1983: A light offshore. A fisherman reportedly saw a light near the reefs. You have heard about this affair but have not agreed to investigate.

rumors.2980: Options — Camera. In Graphics, choose Follow Camera to move the character with the movement keys, or Free to pan the camera. Use the mouse wheel to zoom in play.
rumors.2981: Options — Display and readability. In Graphics, choose windowed or fullscreen mode and an available resolution. Button text size is adjustable; Defaults resets it. HD maps starts detailed map generation.
rumors.2982: Options — Companions. In the game rules, Unlimited companions removes the Charisma-based party limit. Automatic pickup lets companions collect items from the ground. Both settings apply to single-player games.
rumors.2983: Options — Key bindings. The Key bindings tab lets you change keys. Interface and tutorial hints use your configured bindings. You can adapt the controls to your keyboard.
